/science/2026/sep/28/thrilled-huge-swarm.headline: Bogong moth swarms delight NSW residents and may signal species recovery
/science/2026/sep/28/thrilled-huge-swarm.trail: A researcher says sightings of the endangered moth have increased over the last two years, but 'this year has blown them out of the water'.
/science/2026/sep/28/thrilled-huge-swarm.progress: A researcher says sightings of the endangered bogong moth have increased sharply over the past two years, pointing to a possible recovery.

/world/2026/sep/27/lime-bike-profits-dou.headline: Lime's bike-share use nears 700,000 riders a month in England, as profits double
/world/2026/sep/27/lime-bike-profits-dou.trail: The US-owned firm's profits have doubled, with average monthly users at its UK arm surging to nearly 700,000 and sales up by a third.
